policy: fail-closed; only tasks with explicit task-page licence evidence and redistribution permission may be downloaded by this script

protocol_limitations: This task validates retrieval/provenance plumbing and a narrow downstream task, not SCRS's full semantic preservation, retrieval, or runtime claims.
Do not hard-code expected row count; official page sample-count prose is inconsistent with train/test details and hosted data viewer.
Do not alter upstream labels or examples during ingestion.

output_policy: Produce normalized JSONL plus a run-manifest sidecar that records upstream full revision SHA, split, actual row count, retrieval time, output SHA-256, and attribution.
